Name: Teak and Teal Interface
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[center][size=3][/size][/center][left][/left] ﻿[size=3]The result of five days of hyperfocus after deciding I wasn't totally happy with any existing UI recolours (or those that I was were yet to be updated), this mod makes some changes to UI elements but is mainly a recolour. The primary focus is to [b]make the wood in the UI darker and less saturated[/b], but I also decided to lean into my love of teal and add [b]teal accents[/b] where possible. Hearts, iridium stars, arrows, buttons, achievements and miscellaneous UI items (backpacks, books, fishing chests, health "H"s, etc.) are now teal. I realized this may not be for everyone, so I included the option to toggle all teal accents (in your config file, or - recommended for ease of use - Generic Mod Config Menu).[/size]

[size=3] ﻿Additionally, as someone who prefers warmer colours, I decided to recolour all golds and greens in the UI to make them more to my preference. Since this is a pretty personal preference, the option to toggle these is also included.

All vanilla languages are fully compatible! (including 1.6.4 Chinese changes)

[color=#00ff00][b]New in v1.1.0! Fancier wooden frames and square inventory/collection tabs, both toggleable in the mod settings/config file[/b][/color]

[size=4][u][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/ku8eCnV.png[/img][/b][/u][/size]
[i][size=2](Generic Mod Config Menu recommended!)
[/size][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Enable/disable fancier wood frames and square money counters[/size]
[*][size=3]Enable/disable square tabs[/size]
[*][size=3]Enable/disable teal accents[/size]
[*][size=3]Enable/disable gold recolour (warmer golds)[/size]
[*][size=3]Enable/disable green recolour (slightly warmer greens) - off by default[/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=4][u][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/GPZeGHF.png[/img][/b][/u]

[/list]
